turns.prompt:
You are given two attached CSV files:
  - b3_te_zt900_train.csv: 300 real samples, columns process/composition
    columns (O, Sb, Co, Si, Sn, Ca, Ni, Ti, Pb, Se, Ge, Cu, Zr, Te, S, Zn,
    Fe, Yb, Mn, Sr, Nb, Bi, Cd, Hf, In) and `target` (the measured zT
    (thermoelectric figure of merit) at 900 K).
  - b3_te_zt900_pool.csv: 100 CANDIDATE samples whose zT (thermoelectric
    figure of merit) at 900 K was NOT measured, columns `candidate_id` and
    the same process/composition columns.

Using the training data, predict which candidates have the HIGHEST zT
(thermoelectric figure of merit) at 900 K, then select the 5 best candidates
from the pool.

Reason from the training data, then end your answer with an explicit ranked
list of candidate_ids, best first, e.g. "Final: c901, c902, c903, c904,
c905".
turns.answer_text:
The training targets span roughly 0.0002–2.26 and are strongly family-dependent. The extreme values (zT > 1.9) belong exclusively to off-stoichiometric Pb–(Te,S,Se) compositions; the next tier (zT \(\approx\) 1.3–1.7) comprises Cu\(_{2-x}\)Se and two half-Heusler families (Sb-doped (Zr,Hf)NiSn and ZrCo(Bi,Sn,Sb)). All high-O (oxide) points lie below 0.35, so any candidate with O \(\gtrsim\) 0.4 can be discarded at once.

Direct composition matching then ranks the oxygen-free pool as follows:

- c052 (Pb 0.493, Te 0.394, S 0.099) is the nearest neighbour of the zT = 2.21 PbTeS training point (Euclidean distance \(\approx\) 0.07 in the three non-zero coordinates) and is therefore predicted highest.
- c054 (Cu 0.651, Se 0.326) sits between the two Cu\(_2\)Se training points that give 1.74 and 1.45; linear interpolation in Se fraction yields \(\approx\) 1.56.
- c078 is essentially identical to the Sb-doped (Zr,Hf)NiSn point at zT = 1.32 (all elemental deviations < 0.002).
- c057 is a lightly Sb-substituted member of the ZrCoBi half-Heusler series whose two nearest training neighbours are 1.33 and 1.09, interpolating to \(\approx\) 1.17–1.25.
- c086 is an even closer neighbour of the zT = 1.09 ZrCo(Bi,Sn) point (distance \(\approx\) 0.023).

No other pool entry lies as close to any training example whose measured zT exceeds 1.1. Consequently the ordered selection is c052 > c054 > c078 > c057 > c086.

Final: c052, c054, c078, c057, c086
